encoding.why: CRLF from CLion and Visual Studio
bare CR, old Mac: one line for gcc, a break for the textarea
a BOM that is not at the start is not a BOM

dead_whitespace.why: blank line full of spaces: the line STAYS, its content goes
line continuation: gcc accepts it WITH A WARNING, cutting it would silence the diagnostic

untouched.why: final empty line: 38 of the course's 89 templates have one on purpose, it is the line the student types on
no final newline: nothing compiles with -pedantic anyway, so nothing to repair
no-break space: inside a literal it is the student's data, and we do not lex
spaces BEFORE a character: this is not dead whitespace
